title: Yeast growth assays and quantification
protocol: Transform and select yeast on solid YNB medium supplemented with 3% glucose and 1 mM arginine.
Grow cells in liquid YNB medium supplemented with 3% glucose and 1 mM arginine for one day.
Dilute cells 10, 100, 1000, and 10000 times in water.
Drop 5 μL of diluted cells on solid YNB medium containing 50 mM Tris/MES buffered at pH 5.2, 3% glucose, and 0.2, 0.4 or 2 mM ammonium chloride or 1 mM arginine as control.
Document results by scanning the plates at 600dpi in grey scale.
Quantify yeast growth using ImageQuant TL software.
Subtract the average pixel-intensity of each 1000 dilution spots from the agar-intensity-background.
